artworks.title: Blind Orion Searching for the Rising Sun
artworks.description: Poussin's vast Met landscape: the blinded giant hunter rides on Cedalion's shoulders toward the dawn that will restore his sight — Orion as a mountain of flesh under a cool classical sky.

popCulture.title: Orion (constellation)
popCulture.description: The hunter became a sky-map: Orion's belt and sword are still the first constellation many people learn to name — the myth pinned among the winter stars.

popCulture.title: Orion's Belt
popCulture.description: Three aligned stars — Alnitak, Alnilam, Mintaka — keep the hunter's name in everyday speech as the belt that marks him across the night.
